    protected static IoMapping
    AgenticAdHocParseListener.connectorInputOutput(Element connector)
    The connector's input and output mapping as BpmnParseUtil.parseInputOutput(org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.util.xml.Element) builds it, without AgenticAdHocParseListener.CONTEXT_VARIABLES and AgenticAdHocParseListener.OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_VARIABLES: those two are names, read once as text (AgenticAdHocParseListener.declarationInputs(org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.util.xml.Element)), and never built as expressions, so no step evaluates them.
    protected IoMapping
    AgenticAdHocParseListener.refuseAScopeNoAgentCanRun(Element scopeElement, ScopeImpl scope, ActivityImpl activity, Map<String,String> properties, Element connector, boolean agentConnector, boolean template, List<String> limits, List<String> settings)
    What makes the scope one no agent can run: the agent on another element, its marks without its connector, and every refusal of the scope and of its connector before the agent is set up on it.
